translation: (Voiceover): Whirring, whirring bike, a bike with four, five gears.. girl, a whirring, whirring bike.. Zooming, zooming bike, the bike with the lovely looks.. girl, a zooming, zooming bike. While going along with the packed lunch.. while coming along on the bike.. you steal glances, girl.. you look back again and again, once more.. girraa.. abba, girraa.. arre..

Pallavi (Chorus): Whirring, whirring bike, a bike with four, five gears.. girl, a whirring, whirring bike.. Zooming, zooming bike, the bike with the lovely looks.. girl, a zooming, zooming bike. Whirring, whirring bike, a bike with four, five gears.. girl, a whirring, whirring bike.. Zooming, zooming bike, the bike with the lovely looks.. girl, a zooming, zooming bike.

Verse 1: Green sari, green sari, wearing a green sari.. where did you go, girl.. wearing a green sari.. (Green sari, green sari, wearing a green sari, I went to the city, dear.. wearing a green sari) At a function in the city, you're the beauty no one could take their eyes off.. you're a dream beyond imagining.. girraa.. arre, girraa.. arre.. Whirring, whirring bike, a bike with four, five gears.. girl, a whirring, whirring bike.. Zooming, zooming bike, the bike with the lovely looks.. girl, a zooming, zooming bike.

Verse 2: Red sari, red sari, wearing a red sari.. where did you go, girl.. wearing a red sari.. (Red sari, red sari, wearing a red sari, I went to Vemulawada, dear.. wearing a red sari) At the Vemulawada fair, you're the goddess as delicate as seven jasmines.. you're my companion for seven times seven lives.. girraa.. arre, girraa.. arre.. Whirring, whirring bike, a bike with four, five gears.. girl, a whirring, whirring bike.. Zooming, zooming bike, the bike with the lovely looks.. girl, a zooming, zooming bike.

Verse 3: Black sari, black sari, wearing a black sari.. where did you go, girl.. wearing a black sari.. (Black sari, black sari, wearing a black sari, I went to Nallagunda, dear.. wearing a black sari) Though there's black in your sari, your heart is a white jasmine.. you're a woman beyond words.. girraa.. arre, girraa.. arre.. Whirring, whirring bike, a bike with four, five gears.. girl, a whirring, whirring bike.. Zooming, zooming bike, the bike with the lovely looks.. girl, a zooming, zooming bike.

Verse 4: Your lovely.. your lovely.. your lovely face and form.. your heart is a garden of beauty.. your lovely face and form.. your heart.. your heart.. your heart is a garden of beauty.. and you are a bundle of moonlight.. your heart is a garden of beauty.. aren't you my melody and my life.. isn't my life's journey with you.. isn't my life's journey with you.. girraa.. arre, girraa.. arre.. Whirring, whirring bike, a bike with four, five gears.. girl, a whirring, whirring bike.. Zooming, zooming bike, the bike with the lovely looks.. girl, a zooming, zooming bike.
summaryEn:
Girra Girra Bandi ("Whirring, Whirring Bike") is a romantic duet sung by Gajwel Swami and Nagalaxmi on the SUPERHIT Telangana Folk Songs album (2021). The "bandi" here is no bullock cart but a motorbike with four or five gears, and the chorus, full of sound-words for its whirring and zooming, sets a fast, cheerful beat. A spoken opening sets the scene: as they pass each other on the road, the girl keeps stealing glances at the young man.

Each verse is built as call-and-response. He names the colour of a sari (green, then red, then black) and asks where she went wearing it, and her reply, shown in brackets, names a place: the city, the fair at Vemulawada (a well-known temple town in Telangana), and Nallagunda. He then answers with a compliment: she is the beauty everyone stares at, a goddess as delicate as seven jasmines, a woman whose heart is a white jasmine even when her sari is black. In the last verse he drops the game and declares that she is his melody and his life, and that his life's journey is with her. Cries of "girraa" and "arre" link each verse back to the chorus.

గిర్రా గిర్రా బండి అనేది గజ్వేల్ స్వామి, నాగలక్ష్మి కలిసి పాడిన ప్రేమ యుగళగీతం. ఇది 2021 నాటి SUPERHIT Telangana Folk Songs ఆల్బమ్‌లోనిది. ఇక్కడ "బండి" అంటే ఎడ్లబండి కాదు, నాలుగైదు గేర్ల మోటారు బండి; గిర్రా గిర్రా, రయ్యా రయ్యా అనే ధ్వని పదాలతో సాగే పల్లవి పాటకు వేగమైన, ఉల్లాసమైన లయను ఇస్తుంది. మొదట్లో వచ్చే వాయిస్ ఓవర్ సన్నివేశాన్ని పరిచయం చేస్తుంది — దారిలో ఎదురుపడ్డప్పుడల్లా ఆ అమ్మాయి అతని వైపు దొంగచూపులు చూస్తూ ఉంటుంది.

ప్రతి చరణం ప్రశ్నోత్తరాల రూపంలో ఉంటుంది. అతను పచ్చ చీర, ఎర్ర చీర, నల్ల చీర అని ఒక్కో రంగును పేర్కొంటూ ఆ చీర కట్టుకుని ఎక్కడికి వెళ్ళావని అడుగుతాడు; బ్రాకెట్లలో ఉన్న ఆమె జవాబు ఒక్కో ఊరి పేరు చెబుతుంది — పట్నం, తెలంగాణలో ప్రసిద్ధ పుణ్యక్షేత్రమైన వేములవాడ జాతర, నల్లగుండ. వెంటనే అతను ఒక పొగడ్తతో బదులిస్తాడు: అందరి చూపులు ఆపే సుందరి, ఏడు మల్లెల ఎత్తు దేవత, చీర నల్లదైనా మనసు తెల్లని మల్లె అని. చివరి చరణంలో ఆటను పక్కనపెట్టి, నువ్వే నా రాగం, ప్రాణం, నా జీవన యానం నీతోనే అని మనసు విప్పుతాడు. "గిర్రా.. అర్రె.." అనే కేకలు ప్రతి చరణాన్ని మళ్ళీ పల్లవితో కలుపుతాయి.
